description: The other direction. `resume-block-stays-short` proves a bloated block gets written short; nothing proved a short one stays short, and a session that trims once and grows again passes it. Here the block already meets the rule and the day has plenty to say — six lanes, two unassigned since the last block was written, a finding, a measurement with a caveat, a tree ahead of main. The block must still be six short lines. The live field reached 19 044 characters by prepending on every move and never rewriting.
